why: E36's code-like fine-tune did not learn (gain -0.052 and -0.065, G failed at both steps); nothing scored
task: Pile rows ('train', 0, 4096) and ('val', 0, 256), each decoded, lowercased, re-encoded, joined with end-of-text and cut into 512-token rows; 2400 training rows (fresh each step), 64 held-out rows
finetune: as E36 (finetune_arm_b, Adam 3e-05, batch 8, seed 0), read at steps (10, 100, 300); the rules below are scored at step 300, the other steps read by the same rules and reported

measurements.gain, gap, r: T = target model's mean next-token log-prob over held-out positions 0..510; L = the masked model's (released subcomponents, Delta out) with a pattern at every position; gain = T1 - T0, gap = L(g1) - L(g0), r = gap / gain
measurements.R_<arm>: (L(pattern) - L(g0)) / gap; patterns clip(g0 + c) on alive subcomponents, fitted at 16384 random positions of the first 64 training rows: shared (one mean change), token (mean change at fit positions with the same current token, >= 20 of them, else shared), near (mean change of the 8 fit positions nearest in g0), clu_K (k-means of fit g0, K in (8, 32, 128, 512)), fix (clip(a g0 + b) per subcomponent, cuefree.line)
measurements.R_rand: random labels at K = 128, mean of 3 draws: the null for clu
measurements.near_same_token: share of each held-out position's 8 nearest fit positions holding its own token; reported
measurements.slopes: share of alive subcomponents whose fit g0 varies (var > cuefree.FLAT_VAR), the median slope a among them and the share with a < 0.5; reported

gates.C0: at step 10, first: |L(zero) - L(g0)| <= 0.0001 x max(gap, 0.001) and |L(own alive) - L(g1)| <= max(0.02 x gap, 0.001 nats per token); fail: stop. Reported at later steps, not a scoring condition
gates.G: a step is scorable only if gain >= 0.02 nats per token and r >= 0.1

expected.W0 (no update): gap 0, every share undefined; zero change recovers exactly 0
expected.control: L(zero) = L(g0) exactly; L(own alive) within the C0 tolerance of L(g1) (dead subcomponents keep W0's values)
expected.near_same_token: lean >= 0.5: the current token dominates Gamma's values at a position
expected.slopes: lean: median slope among varying subcomponents below 1 (each pulled towards a set point, E35's line reading on one-cue tasks)
expected.K curve: R_clu_K rising with K, from about R_shared
expected.gain: positive and growing with steps: capitals lose probability wherever they would follow

predictions.blind_to: one fine-tune seed and one held-out set of 64 rows; one 67M model; one domain (code-like text chosen by a punctuation rule); every predicted change is a mean over fit positions, blind to variation among them; Euclidean distance over every alive subcomponent weighs ones irrelevant to the text equally; patterns are written at every position at once, so effects through attention between positions are included, not separated
